exact_prompt:
Use case: faithfulHD game diffuseUV edit, exact original paint/material/tonal pattern.
Reference is ENTIRE original source storedRGB enlarged NEAREST only, no artwork changes. Original full alpha retained separately. Edit WHOLE original canvas IN PLACE with exact original aspect and every normalizedUV position, field/blackgap/edgeclipping, materialboundary and shape/count/scale. No crop/padding/recenter/rotate/zoom/repack/BBox/fitting/border, no assembled object/scene or photo. Native coordinate numbers below are constraints only, NEVER text drawn.
Original native64square source, ENTIRENEAREST8x guide512square; final whole256square. Preserve ORIGINAL olive/charcoal painted capUV fields inexactplace: top olive strip and original narrow dark inset ending near center, broad dark charcoal horizontal field under it, wide middle olive horizontal band with its original fine light rim and small flat rectangular source tonebreaks, original large lower-left/center rounded olive shaded field and adjacent charcoal curved trim, original bottom-left small dark rounded field, and bottom charcoal horizontal field clipped at right. Keep original muted olive paint and almost-black charcoal colors; all these broad smooth source areas remain smooth, no newly drawn seam/stitchedgrid/buttons/holes/hardware. Preserve flat source rim and source tonebreaks without raised ridges or new luminous trim.
Only replace coarse pixel steps with very restrained fine soft paint matching original material/scale; existing fine grain can gain resolution, but smooth fields stay smooth. Preserve original relative brightpatch strength, palette/chroma and dark shading; NO stronger shine/new pale or white plates, amplified weak marks, brighter beveled rims, added sharp raised stitches, repeating weave/grid, crust/pits/rough photograin, ornamental scratches/curls/rays or new parts. Keep all original component counts/folds/holes/cutouts and original soft tonalhierarchy. Numeric wholecanvas brightness is handled afterward; do not brighten source details. No invented letters/numbers/logo/emblem/mark/engraving. Output only ENTIRE originalaspect UV texture as opaqueRGB, without labels/comparison.
